title: Local engine upgrades — round 6: four gaps before you sign

steps.surface: New session form → model picked → memory warning
steps.path: Your P-20 note, built: the toggle as a sub-card inside the warning card
steps.headline: Open, the warning card holds the numbers line and, nested inside it as its own small card, the 'Warn me about this model' toggle.
steps.changed: The toggle row now sits inside the warning card's edge, indented, with its own slightly deeper tint, instead of as a sibling row beneath.
steps.notice: One card grows to hold everything; closing it folds the toggle away with it.

steps.surface: New session form → model picked → memory warning
steps.path: The 'too large' case on the new warning row
steps.headline: A too-large model shows the same row in the danger colour and opens to the numbers line only — no 'Warn me' toggle.
steps.changed: Stated, not asked: too-large is not a choice, so there is nothing to remember. Create Session stays blocked, as today.
steps.notice: Nothing yet — this becomes a row of the contract.

steps.surface: Settings → Model Providers → Models → a model's size bubble
steps.path: Where the offer to lower the context length lives
steps.headline: On a 'tight' or 'too large' verdict, the size bubble ends with 'Lower this model's context length in its Settings to shrink this.'
steps.changed: Stated, not asked: you approved 'tight offers to lower context' in words on the first deck; this is the one place it appears — the last line of the hover bubble, under the memory figure. It is not built yet; the build adds it.
steps.notice: Nothing yet — this becomes a row of the contract.

steps.surface: Settings → Model Providers → Models → a model's size bubble
steps.path: The vision file in the size bubble
steps.headline: The size bubble lists 'Vision file (sees images) 0.9 GB' as its own line only for models that have one.
steps.changed: Stated, not asked: the round-3 picture showed a text-only model, so the line was absent; a vision-capable card shows it between Model file and Download.
steps.notice: Nothing yet — this becomes a row of the contract.
